notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - The Arcade Update
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
- The arcade and game bar
- Ball's first game-mode "Bally Bird" has arrived. Click the arcade button in the bottom right to start playing!
- Steam marketplace now accessible from the in-game shop 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed inventory breaking if you had too many crates
- Fixed issue with stacked crates
- Fixed display for resolutions lower than 1080p

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Suggestions & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Save button now shows "game saved!" notification
- Fullscreen is now a toggle
- Added resolution selector
- Resolution settings now save properly
- Clicks per second capped at 50
- Balls now have name tooltip in inventory
- New balls now appear in inventory immediately after opening a crate
- Fixed bug where countdown timer doesn't show after crate drop

Thank you for the bug reports and suggestions in Discord! The ball is rolling... More to come soon!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Quality of Life Patch
notes.content:
- Leaderboard now loads instantly
- Added a global leaderboard refresh every 70 seconds
- Added a countdown timer until next crate drop (for existing players: needs a crate to drop for initial activation)
- Added a background color picker in-app purchase for $0.25 USD

Let us know your thoughts in the Discord!
